_README: THE SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for every Space Peak gate.
Required by ~/.claude/rules/writing-and-gates.md: 'Rules belong in data, not in
a regex. Put the terms, tokens and figures in one machine-readable file. Have a
test assert that every human-facing surface still agrees with it.' That test is
04_tools/space_peak_contract_test.py and it runs in CI and in the hooks.
Nothing in this repository may hardcode a term that belongs here. A new rule
cannot be added without being registered, which is the point: it stops the
prose surfaces (README, CLAUDE.md, voice.md) from drifting away from the
checkers in silence.
If this file and ~/.claude/rules/writing-and-gates.md disagree, that file wins
and this one gets corrected in the same session.
'Block on the certain, warn on the likely.' Blocking on a heuristic teaches
people to bypass the gate, which costs more than it saves.
A check belongs in 'blocking' only if it is deterministic, fast, and
auto-fixable by the author without judgement. Everything a tool's own
documentation would call a heuristic goes in 'warning'.
The contract test asserts these two lists are disjoint and that together they
name every check either checker can emit. An unclassified check is a defect.

_notes.exclusion-proposed: Blocks despite using cue lists, because the site names are literal string matches against a closed two-item list and the consequence is not a style question. The cue lists only decide whether the sentence proposes rather than mentions.
_notes.unattributed-figure: Warns, not blocks. The upstream Photon Mountain script graded this FAIL, but its own docstring calls it a heuristic that 'flags candidates for human review'. Demoted here to match the house rule.
_notes.unregistered-claim: Warns. Regex detection of place-shaped proper nouns is a heuristic by construction.

_README: The two permanent exclusions. Not engineering judgements, so not revisable by
better engineering. These are duplicated in the checker's own constant on
purpose: deleting a row from 02_substance/claims_register.md must not disable
the check that protects it. The contract test asserts the two stay in sync and
that every human-facing surface still names both.
Inverts a proposal cue. Found by running the checker over this repository's
own documentation, which states the exclusion rule and was flagged for
breaking it. An exemption would have been cheaper and wrong: the same
construction appears in ordinary prose ('Blanca is not a candidate'), where
an exemption does not help and a false positive teaches the reader to ignore
the guard.
A figure in a sentence carrying one of these counts as attributed, labelled a
goal, or labelled speculative. The last group is this project's own honest
labelling: the concept brief's discipline is that a mountain fact is
unverified until diligenced, so 'unverified' is as good as a citation for the
purpose of this check.
From ~/.claude/rules/writing-and-gates.md, which is canonical and wins.
'potentially' appears here because the house rules name it. An earlier draft
of 01_doctrine/voice.md argued that conditionals are honest framing for
technology that does not exist yet and un-flagged it. The house file wins; the
divergence now covers only 'could', 'might' and 'may', which the house rules
do not name.

deliberately_absent._why: Conditional, not hedging. Space Peak is a thesis about technology that does not exist, and conditionals are the precise register for a claim you are explicitly not making. The house rules do not name these three.

_README: From ~/.claude/rules/writing-and-gates.md 'No AI tells'. Canonical there; this
is the machine-readable copy the checker reads. Warning severity: a tell is a
judgement call about register, not a certainty.
'Exempt lists are a smell. A hand-maintained list of files to skip will rot.
If you need one, it needs its own contract test.' It does: the contract test
asserts every entry still resolves to a tracked path, so a rename cannot
silently widen the exemption, and asserts every call site reads THIS list
rather than carrying its own copy.
Each entry needs a reason. An entry without one fails the contract test.
